logline: While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.

moments.description: Catherine stands determined in her nightgown, refusing to rot in a cell and plotting to stay on the estate.
moments.key_dialogue: Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate.

moments.description: Alexander tenderly reassures a tearful and insecure Juliana of his unbreakable love and impending marriage.
moments.key_dialogue: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.

moments.description: Lady Ashbourne cruelly glares at a kneeling Catherine in the mud and orders her to be cast out.
moments.key_dialogue: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.

moments.description: Juliana steps in to halt Alexander's guards from expelling Catherine, offering an unexpected twist of mercy.
moments.key_dialogue: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.

moments.description: Juliana dominates Catherine in a psychological battle, offering her shelter only as a humble scullery maid.
moments.key_dialogue: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.

moments.description: A completely broken Catherine accepts her humiliating fate by taking the coarse apron and prostrating herself before them all.
